title: 12 Best Trondheim's Seafood & Norwegian Cuisine
description: Explore Trondheim's top restaurants for authentic Norwegian cuisine and fresh seafood. From Michelin-starred dining to cozy traditional eateries, discover the best culinary experiences in 2026.

places.name: Credo Restaurant
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The full tasting menu with wine pairing is a must for the complete experience.

places.name: To Rom og Kjøkken
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their daily fish catch or the signature King Crab with brown butter.

places.name: Havfruen
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their famous 'Fiskesuppe' (creamy fish soup) or the grilled stockfish.

places.name: Bula Neobistro
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Ask the staff for their current seasonal highlights; the menu changes frequently but often features amazing shellfish.

places.name: Baklandet Skydsstation
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their traditional 'Klippfisk Bacalao' (salted cod stew) or 'Sodd' (meat and vegetable soup).

places.name: Fjordgata 11
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 'Skalldyrfat' (shellfish platter) for a luxurious treat, or the grilled arctic char.

places.name: Søstrene Karlsen
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their 'Kjøttkaker' (Norwegian meatballs) or the 'Dagens Fisk' (fish of the day).

places.name: Kraft Bodega
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Order 2-3 small plates per person to share; their grilled scallops or pickled herring variations are often highlights.

places.name: Tavern på Sverresborg
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their traditional 'Viltgryte' (wild game stew) or the 'Rømmegrøt' (sour cream porridge) for a taste of classic Norwegian comfort.

places.name: Folk og Fe
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Look for their daily specials, which often include unique cuts of fish or beautifully prepared shellfish.

places.name: Brygge Restaurant
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their 'Skrei' (winter cod) dishes are exceptional when in season, or try their pan-fried halibut.

places.name: Vertshuset Grenaderen
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their 'Fårikål' (lamb and cabbage stew, seasonal) or the 'Kjøttkaker med ertestuing' (meatballs with mashed peas) for true Norwegian comfort.
